evelyn_marsh.line: I found another correction. I haven't decided whether it needs me.

rounds.line: Someone put a comma after 'Tenants'. I've taken it out. They can have it back if they miss it.

teresa_vale.line: You can stand there. Just leave me the way through.

patrol.line: Walk with me. If I stop to talk, I start to feel how long I've been on my feet.

lena_ortiz.line: I'm finishing one thing before I offer to mend you. It's an experiment.

work.line: Hold still a second. Everybody stands up straight for a fitting and then goes home to live in an entirely different shape.

juno_kells.line: I'm listening. You needn't make a sound for me.

work.line: Hear that little breath before the first note? I cut it once. Sounded like the music came from an empty coat.

malcolm_reed.line: Leave room for the pot. It has to live here too.

hobby.line: She looks thirsty, doesn't she? Put a finger in the dirt. Wet as Sunday. Good thing one of us asked.

omar_bell.line: Temporary. Mine usually outlive the tags.

patrol.line: I'm listening for a change. If it sounds the way it did yesterday, I get to leave everything screwed on.

rhea_sato.line: I'm not rehearsing just now. It's a difficult distinction from across a room.

ritual.line: I can hit the note cold. The trick is to have something left to say when I get there.

peter_wren.line: There's room beside it. I haven't assigned the space a purpose yet.

ritual.line: That's the copy. I keep the fold in the original. My fingers can tell them apart before I start worrying.

cam_ortiz.line: I've got two shoulders. One's always complaining.

hobby.line: Give it a spin. See the rim kiss the brake once round? That's the part of the bridge I brought home.

noel_price.line: You may use the corner. I cleared it, and now I'm trying to leave it cleared.

hobby.line: I used to write 'miscellaneous'. Took me three afternoons to find out what I meant.

transient_guests.line: We can move the case. We haven't unpacked.

tv.line: Leave it there, will you? If we pick a programme, next thing we'll have a regular night for it.

nadia_quell.line: There's room beside the door. I'd like to keep the doorway.

work.line: Tell me which floor first. I've written 'the door' three times today, and I believe all three of you.

cal_dwyer.line: You can listen. You don't have to know what you're listening for.

work.line: I let a set warm up before I open it. You'd be surprised how many faults are just a fellow in a hurry.

iris_bell.line: The light's changed. Give me a moment before I decide whether I meant that.

work.line: Stand where you were. There. The bit I spent all morning painting disappears behind your shoulder, and I like it better.

sacha_reed.line: I can look at you without the camera. Give me a moment.

work.line: I can tell you the light to half a stop. Ask me which Tuesday it was and I have to start turning things over.

jonah_price.line: There was a sentence here. I'm leaving it somewhere to come back to.

work.line: I read him out loud and he sounds like me. Which is unfortunate. He's supposed to be the sensible brother.

mae_kessler.line: You may leave it on. I wasn't offering to appraise it.

errand.line: I went out without my gloves once. Every person I met felt bound to tell me. Quite a saving on conversation.

stacy.line: Nobody eats standing up unless they're on wages. Sit down.

work.line: You can tell who's waiting for somebody. They turn the spare chair round before they touch the glass.

mae_kessler.line: One moment. That was where I had it. I dislike being corrected by a table.
A chair is not a shelf. I know this room sometimes suggests otherwise.
The tea can wait. It is already cold; it has nothing further to prove.
Price is the easy part. Keeping the card with the thing is work.

nadia_quell.line: Am I in the way? Try the door. People always say no when they mean six inches.
Let her finish. We have both been asking questions at the furniture.

cam_ortiz.line: Made every stop. Now if I could find six inches to put my own feet.
I've stopped. Don't make it an occasion.
I'm checking the next round. Checking isn't going. Noel says I confuse the two.

jonah_price.line: I was reading it aloud. The room has raised an objection, but it won't put it in writing.
That sentence wants another sentence. That's how they get you.
I've gone for water. If the sentence is any good it'll still be there when I get back.
No, don't rescue the word. I crossed it out with considerable effort.

lena_ortiz.line: Come in or stay there, whichever helps. Only let the door choose one of those too.
Turn a cuff inside out. Go on. That's the side that spends all day against your wrist.
Tea. For me this time. You may look surprised quietly.
A loose end isn't an emergency. Give me the one I'm holding first.

cal_dwyer.line: There's no hurry. That's why I put the chair there.
Hear that? Same volume. Move your chair a foot and the whole room sings bass.
The kitchen doesn't need tuning. It's why I come in here.
You can stay another minute. You needn't promise the whole afternoon.

juno_kells.line: Don't tidy on my account. You'll change what the room sounds like.
Give me a second. I've got the sound. If I start naming it now I'll lose it.
I like it here when neither of us is explaining anything.
I keep listening past the end. Habit. You can go if you need to.

omar_bell.line: Put it down, then turn around. I've swept up enough good advice to know.
I'm resting my eyes. If I close them, you'll think I've stopped working.
That can wait. I said it can wait; don't look so pleased with me.

sacha_reed.line: One space to sort into, one to sort out of. You've got your elbow in the second one.
I'm looking at something farther away for a minute. You qualify.
Wait until I've put this down. I'd rather look at you properly.
You can watch from there. I need this side for my elbow; it hasn't learned to be smaller.
When the same speck turns up everywhere I look, it's my eyes. Give them a minute.
Leave that edge alone. I want to know what I'm looking at before I decide what to do.

mae_kessler.line: You may leave your coat on. I wasn't offering to appraise it.
I used to put my tea on the ledger. You could date half my accounts by the rings.
Mind the corner. The furniture cannot move out of your way.

nadia_quell.line: He said four. I have never known him early, so I thought one of us had better be.
